ms.report:
Catalyst Milestone 3 re-submission — Series 2 evidence added. 

 A second distinct CIP-68 option series (M3-Series-2, ADA→GENS Call · strike 0.55 · non-cancellable) was minted on Cardano Preview testnet at 
 transaction hash 20fd27b109ebfc6a6dd888d746fcb054d0e8314eb2b7ad5a2a4df6c5f00d0e81 (block 4,281,747, valid_contract: true). The series mints a paired CIP-68 reference NFT and user NFT under the same AnyMint policy as Series 1, sharing the 28-byte body 94e35fca…2c0d and differing only in the CIP-67 label prefixes 0x000643b0 (ref) and 0x000de140 (user). The on-chain inline datum contains all required fields, explicitly including cancellable: 0 (false — distinct from Series 1's cancellable: 1) and fee_cfg_ref: "" (the on-chain default noFeeConfigNft). Full evidence — transaction hash, asset IDs, decoded metadata JSON, and explorer link — is published in web-options/MILESTONE-3.md § 9 at the public repo:

https://github.com/geniusyield/cardano-options-catalyst-m2/blob/main/web-options/MILESTONE-3.md
